reference: Six adjacent alternating AB/BA blocks, SymPy DomainMatrix on the identical exact polynomial matrix and certificate
statistic: Median per-call reference time over all six blocks, including protocol overhead
margin_rationale: A factor-two absolute ceiling relative to the independently implemented exact operation allows implementation and shared-host variation; it is fixed before the new stage measurements and is not fitted to native times.
rule: Freeze each absolute ceiling as margin times the sum of its reference medians; require the native six-repeat median not to exceed it. Retain every sample and every failure. Live comparator ratios remain informational.
scope: RatPoly and Mv, full and half rank, dimensions 4, 8, 12
timeout_note: The process timeout is independent of this per-operation scientific ceiling.
